name: Network switch symbol
summary: Network symbol for an Ethernet switch, a box with crossing arrows, used on electrical and communication drawings.
description: Ethernet switches are drawn on network and control drawings as a box with opposed arrows, indicating forwarding between ports. Electrical drawings show them in control panels and communication cabinets with their power supply and port connections.

The drawing should tag managed or unmanaged, port count and any PoE capability, since PoE switches power cameras and access points. Ring or redundancy protocols are noted where the network is resilient. The symbol does not show VLANs, IP addressing or configuration. Those belong in the network design documents.
readingNotes: Check PoE capability where powered devices connect.
Read port count and redundancy notes.
distinction: A router connects networks at the IP level; a switch forwards frames within a network.
